reason: RMR is a CRE investment/asset manager that sells management and capital-formation services to sponsored REITs, funds and investors. Orion is a REIT that owns office buildings and leases them to tenants. Both work in US commercial real estate, but they earn money differently (management fees vs. owning and leasing property) and sell to different buyers (REITs and investors vs. tenants).
reason_if_0: Different business model: external fee-based manager vs. property owner earning rent.

primary_services.reason: RMR sells property, asset and capital management to clients. Orion manages its own owned portfolio and does not sell management services.

customer_segment.reason: RMR serves investors, clients and tenants. Orion's buyers are corporate and government tenants. Only the tenant link overlaps.

end_markets.reason: Both operate in US commercial real estate, including office. RMR also covers multifamily, industrial and other sectors.

business_model.reason: RMR is an investment manager and platform. Orion is an owner of net lease office assets.

value_chain_position.reason: RMR is a service provider and manager. Orion is an asset owner.
